material.acceptance_criteria: CI job prints 'wire frames ok types=<n> roundtrip=<n>' and fails on any round-trip mismatch or accepted unknown-version frame. Publish via Git API on remote main (lanmower identity), ci-status green for the full 40-char sha.
material.description: Create js/wire/frame.js (pure encode/decode Uint8Array, no DOM, no Node-only APIs) and js/wire/package.json (no runtime deps). Frames: order (unit id,x,y); state (tick, state hash, unit records id,kind,player,x,y,hp, bounded count); peer hello (protocol version, room); error (code,message). Every frame starts with 1-byte type and 1-byte protocol version; decoders reject unknown version with typed error. docs/WIRE.md documents layout, little-endian, version constant, reject rules. js/wire/test.js round-trip tests run in CI via one appended job in .github/workflows/ci.yml. Do not touch rust/, js/host, js/client. Engine stays genre-agnostic.
material.subject: One versioned binary wire format shared by js/host and js/client
